verdict.rationale: Qdrant has no built-in natural-language console. It does ship first-party agent skills and an official MCP server, so a user can operate it with natural-language commands through an AI assistant. The evidence describes what these artifacts are, not which operations can be done in natural language or how reliably. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface, documentation of which operations the skills or MCP server expose to natural-language commands, and hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Qdrant provides a collection of ready-to-use agent skills that bring Qdrant's vector search capabilities directly into your AI coding assistant.
Install these skills to empower your agent in making critical engineering decisions for optimal vector search performance
